description: DML Shipping Calculator data. Box dimensions and per-product capacities come from the 'Shipping Calculator' workbook (product sheets Caps, TK3, EK9, EK12 and EK64, rows 6-11). The employee-facing names are Toques (TK3 sheet) and EK60 (EK64 sheet). Dimensional weight is calculated from the whole-inch box dimensions; the workbook's own weight estimates are kept only as historical audit data. The app validates this file at start-up. See AUDIT.md before changing capacity statuses.

pricing.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP to the cent (customer shipping price, per piece)

dimensional_weight.service_scope: UPS non-air services only (for example UPS Standard or UPS Ground)
dimensional_weight.rounding: L x W x H in whole inches / divisor, rounded up to the next whole pound
dimensional_weight.measured_weight_rounding: actual measured weight rounded up to the next whole pound
dimensional_weight.quoting_guidance: greater of dimensional weight and rounded-up measured weight, per box
dimensional_weight.source: UPS Canada, Package Dimensions, Size Limits and Weight Guide (ups.com/ca), checked 2026-10-07

boxes.source: Caps!C7:I7 'Catalog/ Cap Box' (same on every product sheet)

capacity_status_legend.approved: Capacity confirmed in the approved release table. Used for automatic suggestions.
capacity_status_legend.auto_audited: Small box whose product capacity was audited as consistent with the workbook and packaging specs. Used for automatic suggestions.
capacity_status_legend.unconfirmed: Workbook lists a capacity, but it appears to be a generic value copied across sheets and was not confirmed for this product. Never suggested automatically; a PM may select it manually and the quote is flagged.
capacity_status_legend.conflict: Workbook capacity contradicts the product's other data. Cannot be selected until DML sets a confirmed capacity here and changes the status.
